$comment: P4-B hand-written response schema overlay, keyed by operationId; merge-contract injects it into openapi.json responses.200.content['application/json'].schema. Catalog code-first schemas win at merge time (merge-contract.mjs prints "catalog response schema wins over overrides"). goals.list / goals.sessions (E10b-1), approvals.list / questions.list / triage.list (E10b-2), memory.search (E10c-1), automations.list (E10f-C) and session.list (E10f-E: catalog already supplied the schema, the override was inert) are code-first now, so their entries were deleted (18 -> 10).

session.messages.description: Session history as MAFW View DTO (flat MafwMessage: {id,role,content,...}). The legacy {info,parts} envelope and the format opt-in were removed in Task 15.

triage.dismiss.description: Dismiss = reject alias (state REJECTED), ledger reason triage_dismissed. Route added 2026-09-17 fixing SDK drift bug.

goals.control.description: PAUSE/ABORT/FORCE_PHASE/RESET_PARAMETRIC. Gateway also accepts legacy POST /control (MCP handler compat) - same handler.

event.subscribe.description: ?sessionID= scopes to a session. SDK helper events.url() returns this URL for renderer-direct EventSource (contract in SDK, transport direct).

tts.speakStream.description: SSE of base64 PCM16 chunks (24kHz mono). SDK helper tts.streamUrl() returns this URL; transport stays renderer-direct (IPC cannot clone the SSE stream).

media.upload.description: Raw octet-stream, ?type=. Must go through Node network stack (Chromium fetch hangs behind system proxies). SDK helper media.upload().

media.uploadAndCreate.summary: Upload + A2A task create in one round-trip

media.artifact.description: TTS audio / uploaded media. Consumed directly by <audio src> via SDK media.artifactUrl() helper - transport stays direct.

project.setCurrent.description: Real register route persists the registry and broadcasts project_registered.

goals.respondQuestion.description: Desktop QuestionWidget. Distinct from /api/questions/{id}/reply (native opencode question API).
